description:
Central Bank Exchange Rates
	

Official exchange rates published by 123 central banks and 6 tax authorities, as one CSV per institution: 16,401,312 rows, the oldest series from 1914, latest table in this mirror 2026-11-16. Collected and published by AllRatesToday and refreshed daily from the GitHub source repository AllRates-Today/central-bank-exchange-rates.
Every row is the figure the institution itself published for that date: the ECB euro reference rate, the Federal Reserve… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AllRatesToday/central-bank-exchange-rates.
